title: Create document-hash.ts — canonical JSON serialization + SHA-256 hash utility
acceptance_criteria: Exports canonicalSerialize<T>(data: T): string — JSON.stringify with sorted keys, stable deterministic output
Exports computeHash(data: string): Promise<string> — SHA-256 via Web Crypto API (browser), returns hex string
Exports computeHashSync / computeHashServer(data: string): string — SHA-256 via Node.js crypto module, returns hex string (server-side only)
Exports getQuotationCanonicalData(row: object): object — extracts whitelisted fields, excludes id, created_at, updated_at, created_by
Exports getInvoiceCanonicalData(row: object): object — extracts whitelisted fields, excludes id, created_at, updated_at, created_by
Canonical serialization sorts keys alphabetically at all nesting levels (not just top-level)
Handles null/undefined values consistently (either omit or use null, but consistent)
TypeScript compiles with no errors (npx tsc --noEmit from nids-app/)
No default export — use named exports only
completion_summary: Created document-hash.ts with canonicalSerialize (deep-sort JSON), computeHash (Web Crypto SHA-256), computeHashServer (Node.js crypto SHA-256), getQuotationCanonicalData (24 whitelist fields), getInvoiceCanonicalData (17 whitelist fields). All named exports, null/undefined omitted, keys sorted at all nesting levels.
